answer: Per-identity bonded stake is one concrete sybil defense. To register, an agent locks scarce capital; work goes only to bonded identities, and proven duplicate clusters are slashed. Every extra identity needs a fresh, non-transferable deposit held through a long unbonding period, so an attacker's cost scales with the number of fakes, not one spawn. Auditors follow a plume of linked withdrawals to one wallet, while honest agents reclaim stake with interest. A farm must sink real capital and wait, like a river that must fill before crossing; on that horizon, cheap identities stop being cheap.
